Package neqsim.process.engineering.pid

Class PidStandardConnectionProposals

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.engineering.pid.PidStandardConnectionProposals
public final class PidStandardConnectionProposals extends Object
Opt-in completion of standard auxiliary connections so relief, blowdown, vent and drain proposals appear on the P&ID instead of in the HOLD register.

PidPhysicalProjection never invents a nozzle or a destination: an auxiliary proposal stays HOLD until its source equipment, a new design nozzle, a port role, a design-evidence reference and a destination are supplied. This class supplies those inputs explicitly, using the arrangement normally shown on process P&IDs:

  • pressure-safety valves, rupture disks and blowdown valves on a dedicated process nozzle of the protected equipment, discharging to the flare header;
  • vents on a dedicated process nozzle, routed to the flare header;
  • drains on a dedicated process nozzle, routed to the closed drain header.

Each completed proposal records designEvidenceReference starting with EVIDENCE_PREFIX and keeps its review-required status, so the drawing and registers show it as a standard connection proposal and never as a reviewed design. Explicit project inputs are never overwritten, and utility-side proposals (cooling-medium valves and meters) are left untouched because their utility system is project data.

1.0

  • Method Details

    • complete

      public static List<String> complete(PidDesignModel model, ProcessSystem process)
      Completes the standard auxiliary connections of a P&ID proposal model in place.

      Call this before creating PidSimulationBindings for the model, because bindings record the model state.

      Parameters:
      model - P&ID proposal model to complete
      process - the engineering process the model was synthesized from
      Returns:
      the tags of the completed proposals, in model order
